d:
Watch Mental Manadhil In A.R. Rahman & Jonita Gandhi’s voice from O Kadhal Kanmani. The fun & breezy song about the desires of a young heart, gets an additional dose of effervescence with Mani Ratnam & A.R. Rahman’s lyrics.
Song Name - Mental Manadhil Female
Movie - O Kadhal Kanmani
Singer - A.R. Rahman & Jonita Gandhi
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Mani Ratnam, A.R. Rahman
Director - Mani Ratnam
Starring - Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menen
